recommendation: Three exact public text-only pipelines; same official full-image performance panel, no parameter regression. Existing Tesseract nonnumeric CPU-only remains unchanged.

models.name: PP-OCRv5 server
models.size_note: Sum of official detector and recognizer stored model sizes, not peak RAM/VRAM; optional orientation/classification modules excluded.

proposed_reference.workload: Warm queued upright text-only pages <=2048px long edge, assumed50 text lines/page; detector+recognizer only, no tables/layout/formulas/LLM postprocessing. Source image corpus line counts unknown.
proposed_reference.method: Inverse source A100 seconds/image, multiplied by explicitly assumed0.25–2x document complexity/workload allowance and1–2.3x H100 pipeline allowance; rounded outward. This is a judgmental planning range, not a measured page benchmark or statistical interval.
proposed_reference.precision: Native Paddle GPU precision; no specific FP16/TRT speed guarantee. Class of model fits80GB plausibly; no measured peak VRAM claimed.
proposed_reference.batch: up to16 queued pages subject to memory; crop batching runtime-specific, no16x throughput multiplier

component_crosscheck.warning: Not a second measurement. Crop timings exclude pre/post; this merely checks whole-page order of magnitude. Never report crop/s as page/s.

models.quality_note: Internal16-category detection Hmean and15-category recognition average are separate tasks; no joint end-to-end quality score. Do not merge recognition accuracy into full-page OCR core quality. v4 absent from this evaluation.

excluded.EasyOCR: Official API supports GPU and batching, but no sufficiently specific author whole-page baseline found in bounded pass. Would require a weaker architecture-only heuristic; prefer three Paddle additions.
excluded.RapidOCR: Toolkit with multiple model/backends, not a distinct fixed checkpoint. Adding generic RapidOCR would duplicate Paddle weights with ambiguous runtime.
excluded.Tesseract: Current reference entry correctlyCPU-only nonnumeric. Official docs recommend one single-thread process/core forqueued jobs; no exact current whole-page host anchor verified here.
